L27n1779.name: Word-fragment starts; brace output
L27n1779.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'Ste' in Stephen or steaming, 'dis' in disintegrates, 'fl' in flaking; pushes the model toward '{' and '({' brace tokens.

L27n662.name: Word stems; parenthesized capitals
L27n662.description: Goes strongly negative on a mid-word stem cut before its ending, e.g. 'init' in Infinitives, 'plac' in placards, 'def' in defied, 'she' in shears; pushes toward '(' followed by a capital letter such as '(A' or '(C'.

L27n2705.name: Proper-name starts; valid
L27n2705.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized proper name split into tokens, e.g. 'Se' in Seel, 'Fe' in Feinberg, 'T' in Tete or T Rex; pushes toward 'valid' and 'Valid' tokens.

L27n1654.name: Split-word fragments; url
L27n1654.description: Fires on word-internal fragments that are not the word's end, e.g. 'ple' in pleura, 'punct' in puncturing, 'ur' in nurtures, 'lux' in luxurious; pushes toward 'url', 'URL' and 'ur' tokens.

L27n419.name: Split-word starts; B-units
L27n419.description: Fires on the leading fragment of a word split across tokens, e.g. 'v' in Nauvoo, 'pend' in Harpenden, 'inn' in cinnabar, 'oct' in octa-; pushes toward unit-style tokens ending in B such as MB, GB, SB and (sb.

L27n2421.name: Word-stem starts; email
L27n2421.description: Goes strongly negative on a short leading stem cut before the word ends, e.g. 'Can' in Canaveral, 'enam' in enamelled, 'lif' in lifespans, 'com' in comrade; pushes toward 'email' and 'Email'.

L27n1207.name: Short c-fragments; cal
L27n1207.description: Goes strongly negative on a short, often lone 'c', 'oc' or '-c' piece that starts a word, e.g. 'oc' in meningococcal, '-c' in anti-cancer, 'c' in cAMP; pushes toward 'cal', 'Cal' and 'CAL'.

L27n2234.name: Place-name fragments; town
L27n2234.description: Goes strongly negative on the first fragment of a capitalized name, mostly places (e.g. 'Camb' in Cambio, 'Serg' in Sergipe, 'Urb' in Urbium); pushes toward 'tile', 'town' and 'village'.

L27n1878.name: Lone f-starts; evaluation
L27n1878.description: Goes strongly negative on a lone 'f' or 'F' opening a word, e.g. 'f' in feral, fidgeting, fashions, farsighted, and Prof; pushes toward 'evaluate', 'evaluation' and 'eval'.

L27n305.name: Electronics specs; device
L27n305.description: Goes strongly negative on digits inside voltage and part-number specs (the '2' in 24 volts or 230 volts) and on electronics terms such as voltage, resistor, EPROM and capacitor; pushes toward 'device' and 'devices'.

L27n2465.name: Capital word-starts; encode
L27n2465.description: Goes strongly negative on the first letter or fragment of a capitalized name or word-initial cluster, e.g. 'B' in Bortnyik, 'C' in Czar or Cossack, 'Fr' in Franks, 'fer' in ferocious; pushes toward 'encode', 'encoded' and 'decode'.

L27n1425.name: Ch-names; angle-bracket tags
L27n1425.description: Goes strongly negative on the capital 'Ch' or 'P' that opens a proper name or word (Chaco, Chakma, Chao Phraya, Chores, Pacific); pushes toward '>' followed by a lowercase letter, such as '>i' and '>d'.

L27n1610.name: Split-word starts; width
L27n1610.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split across tokens, e.g. 'Q' in Qutb, 'Mand' in Mandeb, 'Var' in variances, 'underst' in understudied; pushes toward 'width', 'wide' and 'Width'.

L27n2020.name: Short c/sh fragments; owner
L27n2020.description: Goes strongly negative on a lone 'c', 'C', 'sc' or 'sh' that starts a word after a hyphen or split, e.g. 'Anti-c' in anticancer, 'C' in cigarette, 'sc' in scatters, 'sh' in misshapen; pushes toward 'owner', 'own' and 'ownership'.

L27n1107.name: IPA symbols; closing brackets
L27n1107.description: Goes strongly negative on IPA phonetic symbols and diacritic letters in pronunciation guides or transliterated names (ˈ, ɪ, ə, ḥ, ö, 'Tar' in Tarquin); pushes toward closing quote-and-bracket tokens such as `"])` and `'})`.

L27n1328.name: URL domain parts; file extensions
L27n1328.description: Goes strongly negative on 'www' right after 'http://' or 'https://' and on the domain piece after a dot (e.g. 'hs' in dhs.gov, '.d' in a domain); pushes toward file-extension tokens such as .py, .php, .html and .js.

L27n1483.name: Capitalized name starts; vehicle
L27n1483.description: Fires on the capitalized first syllable of a proper name, e.g. 'Sh' in Shalimar, 'Z' in Zulkifli, 'W' in Waukesha, 'Cl' in Clifton, 'Sl' in Slavic; pushes toward 'vehicle' and 'vehicles'.

L27n1474.name: Pre-verb auxiliaries; closing quotes
L27n1474.description: Goes strongly negative on an auxiliary, adverb or conjunction just before the main verb or key phrase (has, have, probably, first, these, old), e.g. 'has' in 'has seen'; pushes toward closing quotation marks and quote-plus-punctuation tokens.

L27n882.name: Name starts; closing parentheses
L27n882.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized place or person name (Ban|ff, Tan|zam, Ar|agon, Z|aidi) and on 'the' right before a noun; pushes toward closing quote-and-paren tokens such as `")`.

L27n697.name: Pre-noun modifiers; closing braces
L27n697.description: Goes strongly negative on a modifier word right before its head noun (North in North Yorkshire, celebrity in celebrity chefs, bathroom in bathroom sinks); pushes toward closing braces and quote-brace tokens such as } and 》.

L27n832.name: Name fragments before closers
L27n832.description: Fires on a middle or late subword piece of a capitalized proper name in encyclopedic or web text, e.g. 'ella' in Marbella, 'akes' in Marrakesh, 'line' in linezolid, 'Hon' in Honolulu. Pushes toward closing tokens that end a quoted string or bracket, such as "), "], and '),.

L27n711.name: Capitalized name-start fragment
L27n711.description: Goes negative on the short first piece of a capitalized word split into subwords, especially Le, Te, Re, Fe starting names or terms (Leukocytes, Leptin, Tees, Reis, Feinberg). Pushes toward a '+' followed by a capital letter, such as +C and +B, repeated.

L27n587.name: Mid-name fragment, closes code
L27n587.description: Goes negative on a middle piece of a capitalized proper name split into subwords, e.g. 'Z' in KwaZulu, 'A' in Abyei or Agra, 'Dai' in Daiichi, 'I' in ICAO. Pushes toward code closers such as ");, ); and ');, repeated.

L27n1053.name: Word-start fragment, sentence end
L27n1053.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a longer word split into subwords mid-sentence, e.g. 'susp' in suspending, 'Cons' in Consenting, 'purs' in pursues, 'Recon' in Reconnaissance, 'roma' in neuroma. Pushes toward sentence-ending ." and . tokens, repeated.

L27n977.name: Split-word middle piece, quote-period
L27n977.description: Goes negative on a middle piece of a word or name split into subwords, often a capital or hyphen-led fragment: 'ir' in Hirundo, '-K' in Karelian, 'Sk' in Skopje, 'ar' in hypoparathyroidism. Pushes toward a closing quote or paren followed by a period, such as "). and ').

L27n1679.name: Technical word fragment, db
L27n1679.description: Goes negative on an internal piece of a technical or compound term split into subwords: '-H' in McGraw-Hill, 'Schw' in Schwann, 'pharmac' in pharmacodynamic, 'iod' in biodiversity, 'crypt' in cryptanalysis. Pushes toward db and DB code tokens, repeated.

L27n402.name: Unfinished word start
L27n402.description: Fires on a word-initial fragment that is not yet a full word, most often 'sl' or 'pl' (slights, slippers, plasm), plus 't' in tamed and 'h' in hedges, and on an opening '(' before a Latin name. Pushes toward closing quote-comma tokens such as ", and ").

L27n1165.name: Word-start fragment, opens brace
L27n1165.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into subwords when the word is a verb or adjective start: 'j' in jarring or juggling, 'sp' in spiced or spoons, 'spe' in spears, 'p' in patty, 'rem' in remolded. Pushes toward opening braces { and ({, repeated.

L27n712.name: Split-word start, '>' spam
L27n712.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word split into subwords, usually a fragment the next token completes: 'pal' in palatability, 'Por' in porous, 'Ne' in neutrophils, 'Ph' in phases, 'cl' in clots. Pushes toward '>' followed by a lowercase letter, repeated.

L27n2014.name: Name piece, writes exec
L27n2014.description: Goes negative on a first or middle piece of a proper name or split word: 'Mah' in Taj Mahal, 'Ari' in Ariane, 'Lal' in Laliberté, 'ec' in eczema, 'ex' in excommunicated. Pushes toward code tokens exec and execution, repeated.

L27n1720.name: 'f' word-start, writes parse
L27n1720.description: Goes negative on a lowercase or capital 'f' that begins a word or hyphenated piece: 'f' in fable, fangs, fiddled, unfurled; 'F' in Festival or Fifteen; '-f' in forked or filter. Pushes toward parse and parser code tokens, repeated.

L27n1624.name: Word-start piece, writes enum
L27n1624.description: Fires on the early piece of a split word or name, often a short word start: 'mel' in melon, 'pl' in plume, 'wal' in walnuts, 'Reg' in Regrettably, 'P' in Pumsaint. Pushes toward code tokens '(Enum', 'enum' and 'ctx', repeated.

L27n1660.name: Word-start piece, writes config
L27n1660.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into subwords: 'fe' in febrile, 'Le' in León, 'def' in deflection or defocused, 'RIP' and '-de'. Pushes toward config, configuration and Config code tokens, repeated.

L27n2928.name: C-initial word, writes cache
L27n2928.description: Goes negative on the letter 'c' starting a word or hyphenated piece: '-c' in anti-cancer, self-cleaning, protein-coding, candle; 'C' in caffeine, CAGR, Catholicism. Pushes toward cache and Cache code tokens, repeated.

L27n329.name: Word-start, writes c-codes
L27n329.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into subwords: 'Enh' in enhance, 'suff' in suffocate, 'pneum' in pneumonic, 'Terr' in terraces, 'SA' in SAARC. Pushes toward short parenthesized codes ending in c, such as (pc, (rc and bc, and toward strings of capital C.

L27n1589.name: Diffuse prose, writes ')'
L27n1589.description: Goes negative weakly and diffusely across ordinary prose. Strongest on sentence-leading words such as 'yes', 'especially', 'although', 'Further', 'Recent', and on mid-word pieces of split names: 'l' in Borglum, 'ol' in catecholamines. Pushes toward closing ')' tokens such as ") and ).

L27n1421.name: Lead-in word, writes ']'
L27n1421.description: Diffuse. Fires on the content word right after a lead-in phrase such as 'such as', 'for', 'or', 'to be' or 'according to': 'ins' in insight, 'improving' after 'for', 'museum' after 'to'. Pushes toward closing bracket and quote tokens such as 】, ']' and "].

L27n937.name: Lone l/m word start
L27n937.description: Fires on a lone 'l' or 'm' that starts a word or hyphenated piece: 'l' in lagoon, limes, limited, labeled; '-l' in alpha-linolenic; 'm' in mango and mature. Common in fruit and plant lists. Pushes toward opening '(' tokens such as [(, `( and -(, repeated.

L27n1713.name: List commas, writes 'temp'
L27n1713.description: Fires on the comma or semicolon separating items in a list of foods, animals or names: after 'tofu' in 'tofu, beans, or tempeh', after 'salmon' in 'salmon, lake trout'. Also on fragments 'contr' and 'cont'. Pushes toward temp, Temp and Tem tokens, repeated.

L27n979.name: Technical piece, writes res
L27n979.description: Goes negative on an inner piece of a technical or scientific compound split into subwords: 'fractional' in fractional-reserve, 'ag' in microaggression, 'magn' in magnification, 'chlor' in chlorides, 'Saccharomyces'. Pushes toward res and Res code tokens, repeated.
